propositions: Three existing auto-bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-filer) lack dedup tags, stable templates, empty-detail abort logic, and contract documentation, causing duplicate filings and silent breakage.

Heartbeat-alert filer must implement a 2-consecutive-red threshold using workflow run history queries (gh api) to avoid filing on single flakes, with first-red time and run URLs in templated bug bodies.
Binding-drift-alert filer requires dedup and daily accumulation limits without a consecutive-red threshold, since drift is persistent state that cannot self-heal between runs.
Conflict-filer in applier.py needs per-conflict dedup tags (derived from local id + Jira key), abort-if-empty exit codes, templated bodies, and detected_by stamping.
A canonical bug-creation contract must be documented (exact rebar create args, dedup search commands, REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var) and referenced by all filers to ensure well-formed ticket creation.
Accumulation comment dedup must check ticket comment history for marker-line age (skip if <24h old) without introducing new state stores, using the workflow's own run history as durable state.
